title: Austin Expansion: Brodie Lane South
summary:
*   A special meeting was called to focus exclusively on a significant land use issue.
*   The core agenda item was a public hearing concerning the proposed full annexation of the Brodie Lane South area into the city limits.
*   Community input was gathered during the hearing, which was then officially closed, moving the annexation process forward.
